title: Remediation verification of the upload handler fix

verified_findings.original_title: Unbounded read of the request body

remediation_commits.author: Example Agent
remediation_commits.subject: fix(upload): bound the request body read

evidence.explanation: The read is now bounded by http.MaxBytesReader at the configured limit, so an oversized body is refused before it is buffered.

regressions.title: Upload limit error leaks the internal path
regressions.description: The new 413 branch formats the wrapped error into the response body, which includes the server's temporary upload directory.
regressions.remediation: Return a fixed message for the 413 response.
